attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"One might almost call it a self-inflicted inconvenience for the pirates.","reason":"Implies the pirates caused his death; the briefing gives no cause."},{"span":"continues its skirmishes with the Gray Wharf Syndicate","reason":"The briefing only says war was declared; it reports no skirmishes."},{"span":"The relative quiet in Cinder Rest, save for the usual low hum of industry","reason":"Describes life inside the colony, which the reporter cannot know."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"It opens with a copied 'News since your last bulletin:' heading, which breaks character, and the 'self-inflicted' line hints at a cause of death the briefing never gives. The rest is bland, invents skirmishes and Cinder Rest's internal quiet, and gives the old war a full item."}
